p.i: [?]bus paterna gentem nubant. Ita non transferetur Israelitarum hæreditas de tribu in tribum, dum quisque in sua patria tribus hæreditate hærebit. Atque omnis filia hæres instituta, ex quacunque Israelitarum tribuum, alicui tribui suo nuptum locetur, ut Israelitarum quisque paternas hæreditates possideant, ne hæreditates ex aliis in alias tribus transeant, dum Israelitarum quisque in sua tribu hæreditate hærebit. Numeri 36.

Ne cum eis (gentibus) fœdus initote: néve earum miserti[?] fueritis: néve affinita-tem cum eis contrahitote, aut filias ve-stras illorum filiis locando, aut illorum filias vestris filiis conjungendo. Alioqui filios vestros à Iova ad peregrinorum deorum cultum abducent: ita fiet, ut iratus Iova vos brevi perdat. Deuteron.7.
Si quis deprehensus fuerit concubuis-se cum fœmina maritum habente, ambo juxtà moriuntor, tum vir qui fœminam constuprarit, tum fœmina: idq; nefas ex Israe-

page.notes: The first word is cut off at the left edge of the scan; read as "bus" with a doubtful initial letter. "miserti" is printed with a letter that looks like j; read as "miserti" and marked doubtful. The mark after "contrahitote" is a printer's tie or ornament, not a letter; it is not transcribed. "non" after "Ita" is partly obscured by a smudge. The headings LXVII and LXVIII are bare numbered canons and are written as paragraphs. The last line ends mid-word ("Israe-") and continues on the next page.
